summary: L2: validated. 3240 records, every discrete-log certificate re-verified with independent curve arithmetic, and all 1440 measured runs per session replay identically. The paired ratio tw2cj-lazy-lcheck / tw2cj-lazy recomputes to 0.9669 [0.966, 0.968] at k = 20 and 0.9862 [0.986, 0.987] at k = 24 (w = 0). The order holds at w = 0.1 and 1, so P1 holds. The protocol's basis of 'about 4.7 additions over the ladder' is wrong, because additions are unchanged (E1). P3 holds (SD 20/21 unchanged, T ratios 1.244 and 0.912). The 'substantive reading' is a post-hoc interpretation, not a preregistered verdict (E3).
